parole.significato: The letter 𐍈 (ƕ) in the Gothic alphabet.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Gothic *𐍈𐌰𐌹𐍂 (*ƕair, “hwair, cauldron, kettle, pot”).
PIE word  *wĺ̥kʷos From Ulfilas + -an. The first element is Latinized from the unattested Gothic form *𐍅𐌿𐌻𐍆𐌹𐌻𐌰 (*wulfila, “little wolf”), from 𐍅𐌿𐌻𐍆𐍃 (wulfs).
